mathematical_checks.validation_level: Informal mathematical checks against definitions and theorem interfaces; not Lean-checked, not a proof-step audit

algorithm_counterexample.generator: G(n,xs)=((n,n+2),0) on ColumnPoint=(Nat x Nat) x Nat
algorithm_counterexample.all_block_nonmembership: Membership in block j would force j=i+1 and i+3<i+2, impossible for every i,j
algorithm_counterexample.hit_sets: empty for every j, hence finite

mathematical_checks.conservative_construction: Finite forbidden sets and an infinite increasing outside enumeration force infinitely many acceptances; stronger test preserves both directions of conflict freedom. Infinite selected prefixes give a single target per generator and varying admissible streams per threshold, sufficient for nonuniform failure.
mathematical_checks.dimension_empty_case: No-witness cases exist, e.g. singleton full-universe class; boundedness true, numeric maximum unspecified. Zero extension is compatible but not claimed as source or Lean definition.
mathematical_checks.quantitative_square_root: For finite maximum N>=1, restrict to floor(sqrt(N)) squared and apply exact witness transfer; zero trivial under explicit zero convention; unbounded case follows for arbitrary k.
mathematical_checks.threshold: A bound D gives t+1>D observations by every t>=D; finite closure would contradict witness bound. Fresh-closure choice supplies correctness. No least-threshold or runtime claim.
mathematical_checks.infinite_witness_packaging: Named native infinite column class available; alternatively finite target obligations vacuous because injective stream range would be finite, so trimming finite targets preserves separation existence.
mathematical_checks.p06_assemblies: Forward generator bridges and finite-sample dimension equivalence support sufficiency; native P19 fixed-level iff supports necessity. No reverse generator-model equivalence inferred.

qualifications: countable ambient-type extension only adds vacuous finite-universe cases
